preflight_status: Physical route guard passed on one hosted runner; companion Windows production identity query timed out after 12 seconds. Readiness is not established for full controlled acceptance.

default_branch.requirement: Separate approval for a narrow manual-only launcher; no merge of the product PR and no untrusted PR checkout

secrets_proposed_for_user_secure_entry_o.OPENROUTER_API_KEY: User-authorized test credential with a verified numeric provider-side spending cap; never copy from sera dotenv

VLESS_NODE_JSON.format: Exactly one authorized VLESS/TCP/REALITY/Vision node; strict structured fields, no complete profile, subscription URL, rules or providers
VLESS_NODE_JSON.protection: No value or derived field in logs/argv/artifacts; validate without serializing input; never copy desktop configuration

not_secrets.controller_token: Generate ephemerally within the disposable job, never print, discard during cleanup
not_secrets.dns_endpoint: Must be explicitly approved; propose 1.1.1.1:53 UDP with TCP fallback
not_secrets.github_runner_cost_or_quota: Use standard runner only; do not enable paid capacity or billing changes

required_before_activation: Review the observed physical-route guard outcome; rejection must not be bypassed
Explicitly authorize real DNS/TLS, the selected proxy service, OpenRouter endpoint and at most two total model attempts
Confirm a numeric provider-side monetary cap; attempt count alone does not cap money
Prepare and review a complete harness, official Mihomo version/hash and final pinned code SHA
Approve any narrow default-branch launcher change separately
Configure protected manual approval and user-entered secrets without exposing them to ordinary PR CI
future_harness_constraints: Standalone loopback-only Mihomo; no FlClash, TUN, system proxy/DNS/route/firewall or account privilege changes
Use unmodified production collector, Jev parser, policy and physical-path/identity guards
First real model request is the service-availability check and consumes the total budget; fail without retries or fallback model
No fabricated failures or broader targets to force a PROXY decision
Real nonempty learning, proxy coverage and Windows desktop integration remain separate claims
Drain/empty only owned providers; stop only verified owned processes; erase private temporary inputs before job deadline
Typed allowlisted aggregate results only; no raw stdout/stderr, addresses, UUIDs, credentials, complete model responses, cache or artifacts

historical_acceptance.scope: These are valid historical scoped passes, not rerun by the native identity regression and not proof of real external/model acceptance.
